flashcard_classes.title: Word categories
flashcard_classes.desc:
Lango uses a machine learning model that analyses your learning and estimates how well you remember each word.

Based on that, every word is assigned to one of three categories:
flashcard_classes.class_3_desc: Words you already remember very well.

report1: Your dictionary is still quite empty.. *Add a few words* to start learning and track your progress 📚 Every new word brings you closer to mastering the language!
report2: It's time to study ⏰ Click the button below to start your session 👇
report3: You already know *{{wellKnownWords}}* words well, but it's not time to rest. Click the button below to continue learning 👇
report4: Our estimates suggest you have mastered *{{percentage}}%* of the words you've recently added to your dictionary. Click the button below to continue learning 👇
report5: At the moment, we estimate that you've mastered *{{percentage}}%* of the words you've recently added to your dictionary. You already know *{{wellKnownWords}}* words well! Maybe it's time to add something new? 🤔
report6: At the moment, we estimate that you've mastered *{{percentage}}%* of the words you've recently added to your dictionary. You already know *{{wellKnownWords}}* words well! Click the button below to master the rest 👇
wordsSuggestion: Do you already know these words?
wordSuggestionDesc: Hit card to add word to your vocabulary.
activityDesc: Your study sessions over the past months.
gradeDistributionDesc: See how well you know your words.
logout_confirm: Are you sure you want to log out?
logout_desc: Don’t worry, you can always come back
howWell: How well do you know this word?
no_updates: No words were evaluated. Add some to your dictionary and try again!
perfect: Amazing! You mastered all {{grade3Count}} words perfectly. You should be proud! Is learning becoming second nature to you?
goodProgress: Congratulations! You know {{grade3Count}} words perfectly. Great job! There are still {{grade1Count}} words that need attention, but you're on the right track!
balancedEffort: Great effort! You’ve mastered {{grade3Count}} words perfectly. {{grade2Count}} need a bit more practice, and {{grade1Count}} need your attention. A productive session!
needsImprovement: Don't give up! In this session, {{grade1Count}} words were challenging, but that means there’s plenty to learn. Remember, repetition is the key to success!
steadyImprovement: Your practice paid off! {{grade2Count}} words are at a decent level, but there’s still room for improvement. You also mastered {{grade3Count}} words perfectly!
bothInputs: You have to fill both inputs.
alreadyExists: This flashcard already exists in your dictionary.
soFar: So far, you have added *{{wordsCount}}* words to your vocabulary.
brag: We don't want to brag, but we've added a little extra to that, as *{{langoWords}}* of them come from *Lango*!
avgGradeThree: On average, you know *{{avgGrade}}%* of your words perfectly.
goodJob: Keep it up, and you'll see even better results soon!
badJob: It is not that much... maybe it's time for a new study session?
nextTime: Next time, you definitely have to try adding some flashcards from Lango!
removingFlashcardDesc: Are you sure you want to remove this flashcard?
finishingSessionDesc: Are you sure you want to leave the session? We will save your progress.
choose_theme: Choose a color theme that suits your style and makes learning feel just right.
choose_language_main_desc: Click on a tile to select the language you want to learn.
choose_language_translation_desc: Click on a tile to select the language you know best.
choose_language_application_desc: Click on a tile to select the language you want to use the app in.
settings_long_desc: Customize the appearance, behavior, and preferences of the app so that it perfectly matches your workflow.
words_desc: Take a look on your {{words_number}} added words
words_desc_s: Take a look on your added word
words_desc_empty: You haven't added any words yet
loading_content_desc: Be patient! It will take a while to load your data.
welcome_desc: ... an app that will help you finally master new words and make sure you remember the ones you learned in the past
no_items_desc: Try adding some words to your vocabulary.
no_items_filter_desc: Try changing the filters to see more words.
start_search_desc: Try to type something above to search for a flashcard.
select_level: Tap the appropriate tile with the grade.
turn_on_notifications_desc: Short reminders help you stay consistent and keep your streak going.
notifications_disabled_message: To enable notifications, you need to change the app settings in your system.
update_app_desc: Update the app to stay up to date with all the news.
welcome_onboarding_desc: We are very pleased that you have joined our community! Answer a few questions so we can better tailor the app to your needs.

theme.pink_desc: The scent of peonies in a Parisian flower shop.
theme.red_desc: Ripe cherries picked at high noon.

sorting.title: Sorting order
sorting.desc: Choose how flashcards are sorted in your library.

mastery_filter.desc: Choose which flashcards to display in your library.
mastery_filter.title: Filter flashcards

hit_flashcard_bottom_sheet.title: Tap the flashcard to flip it 🤏
hit_flashcard_bottom_sheet.desc: First, try to recall the meaning of the displayed word, then tap to check the correct answer.

word_suggestion_bottom_sheet.title: New word suggestion ✨
word_suggestion_bottom_sheet.desc: You see a flashcard suggestion that is not yet in your dictionary.
word_suggestion_bottom_sheet.desc2: If you want to add it, rate how well you know it. If not, skip it using the arrow in the bottom right corner.

microphone.no_permission: No permission to use the microphone 🎤
microphone.desc: To use this feature, you need to grant the app access to your microphone. You can do this in your device settings.
microphone.disabled_message: To enable the microphone, you need to change the app settings in your system.

language_level.select_desc: Click on a tile to select the level that best describes your language proficiency.
language_level.beginner_desc: You know basic words and simple phrases.
language_level.elementary_desc: You get by in basic everyday situations.
language_level.advanced_desc: You speak fluently on various topics and understand complex content.
language_level.proficient_desc: You speak fluently and precisely, and understand nuances.

press_arrow_to_skip_suggestion: If you would like to skip this suggestion, press arrow to the right
delete_account_desc: Press if you want to delete your account.
delete_account_sheet_desc: To delete the account associated with the email *{{email}}*, enter your email address below. Remember that this operation is irreversible, and all your data will be permanently deleted.

same_learning_language.title: Are you sure?
same_learning_language.desc: Are you sure you want to learn the same language as your native language? You'll make the most progress by choosing a different language to learn.

word_selection.title: Add your first words
word_selection.desc: Click on tiles to select the words you'd like to add to your dictionary first.
word_selection.searching: We're looking for the best suggestions for you
word_selection.skip_confirm: Are you sure you don't want to add any flashcards?
word_selection.skip_confirm_desc: Even a few words will make your learning more effective from the very start!
word_selection.load_failed_desc: You can still continue without selecting words.

onboarding.onboarding_desc: You have customized the app to your preferences, now it's time to learn! Click the button below to start your first learning session.

bundles.title: Bundles
bundles.desc: Create your own word bundles tailored to whatever you're learning right now, and keep your learning organized 📚
bundles.add_new_desc: You can create a new bundle or join an existing one by entering the code its creator shared with you.
bundles.join_with_code: Join a bundle with a code
bundles.create_new_desc: Give your bundle a name and description. You can always change them later.
bundles.no_bundles_desc: Create your first bundle to start learning.
bundles.no_recommended_bundles: We don't have anything at your level to suggest right now. Check back later!
bundles.start_search_desc: Type the name of the bundle you're looking for.

bundle_details.edit_bundle_desc: Change the bundle's name and description.
bundle_details.show_in_main_collection_desc: Words will be part of your main collection
